info.title: Insite View API
info.description: Contract for the Insite View web app and iOS app. See docs/PLAN.md §7.

get.summary: Every building I can open: my organizations' buildings, buildings shared with me, and saved ones.

post.summary: Saves a live building (by its code) to my account.

get.summary: Systems, colours, element kinds and property labels in en / pt-BR / es. Cache by ETag.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the catalog you have; 304 when it's still current.

post.summary: Records a "Fix here" made in AR. Once fixes from several devices agree, the room's correction is in the manifest.

delete.summary: Revokes a grant or cancels a pending invitation.

post.summary: Accepts a building or organization invitation as the signed-in user.
A batch of up to 100 analytics events, with a visit token (guests) or a user token plus buildingId.

delete.summary: Deletes the account (App Store 5.1.1(v)). The sole owner of an organization with other members must transfer ownership first.

get.summary: The signed-in user and their organizations.

patch.summary: Updates name, language, units or the trial email subscription.

post.summary: Stops the trial emails for the user in the signed token from the email. Account emails still arrive.

get.summary: Documents the building's company shared with guests, within the visit's systems.
Elements and rooms of the building matching q (e.g. "tomadas cozinha").
Search within the visited building, limited to the visit's systems.
Buildings, rooms and elements across every building I can open.
Scans, visitors, AR sessions and the most viewed systems (internal visits excluded).
What changed on the building, newest first: versions, go-live, access, PIN, activations.
Stat tiles and the building table with 30-day scans.
Tiers, packs and prices in the country's currency (BRL for BR, otherwise USD).

post.summary: Activates a building for 10 years with credits.

get.summary: Checkout status for the return page (poll until Paid).

post.summary: Grants or adjusts an organization's credits (superadmin, audited).

get.summary: Download links for the original model files of every version and for every document.
Signup → twin ready → live → first external visit → first paid activation, per signup week; failure rates.
The process is up.
The database and file storage are reachable.

post.summary: Creates an account and signs in.
Signs in with email and password.
Rotates the refresh token (body for iOS, cookie for the web) and returns a new access token.
Revokes the refresh token's whole family.
Creates an organization; the caller becomes its owner and the 14-day trial starts.
post.description: `timeZone` (IANA, e.g. the browser's) defaults from the country. Analytics days are counted in it.

get.summary: Organizations the caller belongs to.

patch.description: Changing `timeZone` rebuilds the organization's daily analytics in the background.

get.summary: Buildings of an organization, newest first.

post.summary: Makes the building's QR codes work ("Generate building QR"). Free for up to 3 buildings during the trial.
A 1-hour link to open the twin on your own phone before going live. Visits through it don't count.
Hides the building from the company's lists. Its QR codes keep working as before.
Starts a new version: one multipart upload per IFC file.

get.summary: Version history, newest first.
Status, processing steps, error and stats.

delete.summary: Cancels an upload that hasn't been submitted, or removes a failed version.

post.summary: Presigned PUT URLs for parts of one file (valid 1 hour).
Checks every file arrived and queues processing.

get.summary: The manifest of the current (or a given) ready version, with every system.
All properties of one element. The id is the e-prefixed hex GlobalId used as node name.
The building's QR plates; plate 1 is created when the building goes live.

post.summary: Adds a plate (for a panel, a riser, a room). Numbers are never reused.

get.summary: Print sheet: every plate at its exact size, with the building code and cut lines. Print at 100%.

patch.summary: Label, size and placement. The placement is sent in a version's model coordinates and stored in IFC coordinates.

delete.summary: Removes a plate; its printed code then opens the building like plate 1. Plate 1 can't be removed.

get.summary: The AR reference image: the QR with its 4-module quiet zone, about 1024 px wide; its printed width is the plate's sizeMm.
Rooms of the current version that have a correction or visitors' fixes.

put.summary: Saves an admin's correction of a room, sent in a version's model coordinates. It outranks the visitors' consensus.

delete.summary: Removes a room's correction and the visitors' fixes: the room starts over from the model.

post.summary: Removes the admin's correction of a room and keeps the visitors' fixes.

get.summary: Guest landing summary. Codes are case-insensitive and may use the IV-XXXX-XX form. Always 200 with a status for existing codes.

post.summary: Starts a visit from a QR code (device ID in X-Device-Id). With a PIN building and no PIN, the visit sees architecture only.
Starts a visit from a temporary or preview link.

get.summary: The visited building's manifest, limited to the visit's systems.

post.summary: Enters the building PIN for this visit; returns a new visit token with every system.

put.summary: Turns the guest PIN on or off, or changes it. Guests without the PIN see architecture only.

get.summary: Temporary links, newest first (preview links are not listed).

post.summary: Creates a temporary link limited to some systems. The URL (with its token) is returned only here.

get.summary: People with access: accepted grants and pending invitations.

post.summary: Invites someone by email to see the building (optionally only some systems, until a date).

get.summary: What an invitation is for, so the page can explain it before sign-in.

post.summary: Emails a new confirmation link to the signed-in user.
Confirms the email with the token from the link.
Emails a reset link if the account exists. Always 202, so emails can't be probed.
Sets a new password with the token from the link and signs out every session.

get.summary: The social sign-in providers this environment has keys for.
Redirects to the provider. returnTo must be on the web origin or the app's callback URL.

post.summary: Exchanges the one-time code (valid 60 s) for tokens.
iOS Sign in with Apple: the identity token (and authorization code on first sign-in) → tokens.

patch.summary: Changes a member's role or transfers ownership. The last owner can't be demoted.

delete.summary: Removes a member, or leaves when it's yourself. The last owner can't leave.

post.summary: Invites someone by email; they accept at {web}/invite/{token}.
A presigned PUT for the logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB, shown as uploaded).

put.summary: Uses the uploaded logo on guest pages and print sheets.

post.summary: Switches what guests see to this ready version. Plates carry over through IFC coordinates.
Runs processing again for a failed version.
A presigned PUT for the WebP snapshot of the viewer (up to 1 MB); then POST /thumbnail/complete.
Checks the uploaded snapshot and shows it on the guest landing and in lists.
"Send us your files": asks Insite View support to look at a version.

get.summary: Systems review: elements grouped by source IFC system and class, with the system each group got.

put.summary: Saves the building's system mapping and rebuilds the current version with it.

get.summary: Documents of a building; filter by element with ?elementId=.

post.summary: Registers a document and returns a presigned PUT (PDF, JPEG or PNG; up to 100 MB).
Confirms the upload after the PUT.

get.summary: Failed versions across all organizations, newest first.
Organizations, newest first; q matches the name or an owner's email.
Download links (1 hour) for a version's uploaded files.

post.summary: Runs a failed version again, or rebuilds a ready one into a new asset revision.
Reprocesses every version built by an older converter (after a converter upgrade, PLAN §9).
post.description: Versions run one at a time on the processing queue, each into a new asset revision; guests keep the old one until it's done. Versions already waiting for a reprocess are skipped.

get.summary: Credit balance, trial, the last 50 ledger rows and activations.

post.summary: A checkout for activating buildings (exactly the credits they need) or for a credit pack: Stripe for USD, Asaas (Pix, boleto, card) for BRL.
Activates several buildings with credits, all or nothing.

ActivityItem.description: string ActivityItem.Action is one of the audit actions (e.g. `version.ready`, `pin.changed`); JsonElement ActivityItem.Data its details.

AuthResponse.description:
string? AuthResponse.RefreshToken is only returned to native clients. With the `X-Client: web` header the
refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie on `/v1/auth` instead.

BillingDetailsRequest.description:
Who Brazilian invoices (NFS-e) are made out to. string BillingDetailsRequest.TaxId is a CPF or CNPJ (numeric or alphanumeric),
punctuation allowed; string BillingDetailsRequest.PostalCode is the CEP; string BillingDetailsRequest.AddressNumber may be "S/N".

BillingResponse.description:
bool BillingResponse.LowCredits: 2 or fewer left after buying some ("Buy 10 and save 15%"). PaymentProvider BillingResponse.Provider takes
the organization's payments; bool BillingResponse.BillingDetailsRequired: Asaas needs the invoice details first.

BuildingAnalyticsResponse.description:
Non-internal activity over int BuildingAnalyticsResponse.Days days (rolled up hourly). double BuildingAnalyticsResponse.ObjectOpenedShare is the
share of visits that opened at least one element card: "87% of service visits used the digital twin".

converterVersionBelow.description: Reprocess versions built by a converter older than this (e.g. `1.1.0`); versions with no recorded converter count as older.

currentOnly.description: Only the versions buildings show (default). Older ready versions are rebuilt when they're made current again.

dryRun.description: List what would be reprocessed without enqueuing anything (default).

limit.description: At most this many versions per call (default 200, max 1000); call again for the rest.

matched.description: Versions matching the filter, including those over the limit.

enqueued.description: Versions queued now (0 on a dry run).

versionIds.description: The versions this call selected (at most the limit), oldest first.

CheckoutPix.description: The Pix "copia e cola" code (the app draws the QR from it) and until when the QR code works.

CheckoutResponse.description:
Uri? CheckoutResponse.Url: Stripe's checkout page, or Asaas's invoice page (boleto and card). CheckoutPix? CheckoutResponse.Pix is set for
open Asaas checkouts when Pix is available. Unpaid after DateTimeOffset CheckoutResponse.ExpiresAt, it becomes Expired.

CreateCheckoutRequest.description: IReadOnlyList<Guid>? CreateCheckoutRequest.BuildingIds for `Activation`; int? CreateCheckoutRequest.Pack (10 or 50) for `Pack`.

CreatedLinkResponse.description: The token only appears here, once: share Uri CreatedLinkResponse.Url or its QR.

CreateLinkRequest.description: IReadOnlyList<string>? CreateLinkRequest.Systems: system keys from the catalog; null or omitted means every system.

CreateVisitRequest.description:
The device ID goes in the `X-Device-Id` header (a random UUID the app or browser keeps);
string? CreateVisitRequest.DeviceId in the body is accepted when the header can't be set.

Discipline.description: What the uploader says a file contains; the converter uses it as a classification hint.

DocumentRef.description: A document linked to an element; Uri DocumentRef.Url is a presigned download valid for 15 minutes.

DocumentResponse.description: Uri? DocumentResponse.Url is a presigned download link valid for 15 minutes (null until the upload is confirmed).

DocumentUploadResponse.description: PUT the file to Uri DocumentUploadResponse.UploadUrl with `Content-Type: {ContentType}`, then call `/complete`.

props.description: Property sets by name, then properties by name.

ElementResponse.description:
An element's details. string? ElementResponse.GlobalId, string? ElementResponse.IfcClass and IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>> ElementResponse.Props are technical
details for members: null and empty for guests, link and grant visitors (PLAN §9).

EventInput.description: JsonElement? EventInput.Props is a small JSON object; the fields per type are listed in PLAN §12.

EventsRequest.description: Guid? EventsRequest.BuildingId is required with a user token and ignored with a visit token.

ExportResponse.description: Links are presigned for DateTimeOffset ExportResponse.UrlsExpireAt; ask again for fresh ones.

FunnelWeek.description:
One signup week (ISO week of the organization's creation) and how many of its organizations reached each
A-09 step. "Live" is the go-live action; "Visited" is the first non-internal visit (the activation metric).

GrantRole.description: Labels for the company; every grant role sees the building read-only, limited to its systems.

InvitationResponse.description: What the invitation page shows before the person signs in.

InviteMemberRequest.description: Invite as `Member` or `Admin`; ownership moves with `PATCH …/members/{userId} {role: Owner}`.

LedgerRow.description: Uri? LedgerRow.InvoiceUrl: the NFS-e PDF of a purchase, once the city has authorized it.

LogoUploadResponse.description: PUT the image to Uri LogoUploadResponse.UploadUrl, then `PUT /v1/orgs/{orgId}/logo {key}`.

ManifestFile.description: long ManifestFile.Bytes and string ManifestFile.Sha256 describe the file after transfer decoding.

ManifestPlate.description: A placed plate in this version's model coordinates, with the image iOS registers for AR.

ManifestResponse.description:
The manifest clients load a building from (PLAN §9): chunk files as presigned URLs, only the
chunks the caller's scope allows. URLs expire at DateTimeOffset ManifestResponse.UrlsExpireAt; fetch it again then.

ManifestRoomCorrection.description:
A room's correction in this version's model coordinates: turn by double ManifestRoomCorrection.Yaw radians about +Y through
IReadOnlyList<double> ManifestRoomCorrection.Pivot, then move by IReadOnlyList<double> ManifestRoomCorrection.Offset (horizontal, y = 0). A model point p of the room is
really at Rot(yaw)·(p − pivot) + pivot + offset.

ManifestSpaceResponse.description:
A room; element meta refers to it by string ManifestSpaceResponse.Id (`r`). `floorY` is its floor height and
`outline` its floor outline as model [x, z] pairs seen from above, the room on the left of every edge
(inward normal = up × (next − this)); both are null when the file has no room geometry. `correction` is
where the room really is compared with the model, when an admin saved it or visitors agree on it.

MyBuildingResponse.description:
One building the caller can open. string MyBuildingResponse.Role is the organization role (Owner, Admin, Member) or the
grant role (Owner, Viewer, Contractor); IReadOnlyList<string>? MyBuildingResponse.Systems null means every system.

OrganizationRole.description: Ordered from least to most privileged, so roles compare with `>=`.

PageOfActivityItem.description: Cursor pagination (PLAN §7): pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`; null means the last page.

PageOfAdminOrganizationResponse.description: Cursor pagination (PLAN §7): pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`; null means the last page.

PageOfBuildingResponse.description: Cursor pagination (PLAN §7): pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`; null means the last page.

PageOfFailedVersionResponse.description: Cursor pagination (PLAN §7): pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`; null means the last page.

PartUrl.description: PUT the part's bytes to Uri PartUrl.Url and keep the response's `ETag` header.

PaymentProvider.description: Who takes the money (PLAN §11): Asaas for BRL (Pix, boleto, card), Stripe for USD (card).

PlatePlacementRequest.description:
A placement in the model coordinates (metres, Y-up) of Guid PlatePlacementRequest.VersionId, as the viewer shows it.
IReadOnlyList<double> PlatePlacementRequest.Normal points out of the wall; IReadOnlyList<double> PlatePlacementRequest.Up is the plate's up direction.

PlateResponse.description:
int PlateResponse.SizeMm is the printed width of the plate image, quiet zone included. Uri PlateResponse.ImageUrl
is the AR reference image (about 1024 px).

PricingResponse.description: Prices in minor units (cents / centavos) of Currency PricingResponse.Currency.

PublicBuilder.description: Builder branding; both are null when the company turned branding off. The logo arrives with M3 branding.

PublicBuildingResponse.description: What a guest landing shows before anything else (PLAN §5, "QR scan → AR").

RefreshRequest.description: From the iOS app; the web sends the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie instead.

RoomAdjustment.description: How far a room is moved (metres) and turned (degrees) from the model.

RoomCorrectionResponse.description:
A room's corrections. RoomCorrectionSource? RoomCorrectionResponse.Source is the one in use (null: none yet). RoomAdjustment? RoomCorrectionResponse.Visitors is set once
int RoomCorrectionResponse.DevicesNeeded devices agree, even under an admin's correction, so the two can be compared.

RoomObservationRequest.description:
A "Fix here" in AR, in the visited version's model coordinates. string? RoomObservationRequest.BaseSpaceId is the room the
alignment that was placing the building was made in (null: a plate on no room's wall), and
double RoomObservationRequest.BaseDistance its distance to the fix (metres). IReadOnlyList<double> RoomObservationRequest.Anchor is the model corner fixed;
IReadOnlyList<double> RoomObservationRequest.MarkInBase is where it really is, in the base room's model frame (the mark brought in by that
room's alignment). double? RoomObservationRequest.Turn is the room's turn relative to the base room (radians about +Y), only
when the fix measured it. bool RoomObservationRequest.HasTranslation is false for a fix against a wall (it gives the turn,
not where the room is along the wall).

SearchHit.description:
One result. string SearchHit.Id is the element or space id (`e{hex}`) to select in the viewer.
string SearchHit.Title is the element's name, or its kind in the caller's language when it has none.

SetPinRequest.description: string? SetPinRequest.Pin is required when enabling a PIN for the first time or changing it.

SetRoomCorrectionRequest.description: A room's correction in Guid SetRoomCorrectionRequest.VersionId's model coordinates, as in the manifest's `correction`.

SystemGroupResponse.description:
One group in the systems review: elements that share a source IFC system name and IFC class, with the
Insite View system they were assigned and why (string? SystemGroupResponse.ClassifiedBy).

SystemOverridesResponse.description: bool SystemOverridesResponse.Reprocessing: the current version is being rebuilt with the new mapping.

UpdateMemberRequest.description:
OrganizationRole UpdateMemberRequest.Role Owner by an owner makes the member an owner too; with bool UpdateMemberRequest.TransferOwnership the
caller steps down to admin at the same time.

UpdatePlateRequest.description: Every field is optional; bool? UpdatePlateRequest.ClearPlacement removes the placement.

UploadTarget.description: Upload the file in int UploadTarget.PartCount parts of long UploadTarget.PartSize bytes (the last one smaller).

VisitPlatform.description: Where a visit was opened. New values are only ever appended.

VisitResponse.description:
Send string VisitResponse.VisitToken as `Authorization: Bearer …` to the `/v1/visit/*` endpoints.
IReadOnlyList<string>? VisitResponse.Systems null means every system. bool VisitResponse.PinLocked: the building has a PIN the guest
hasn't entered, so only architecture is visible until `POST /v1/visit/unlock`.
bool VisitResponse.ReadOnly: an expired building, shown as an archive.

Visit.description: Visit token from a public visit (audience iv-visit).
